phase_name: Sticky Chrome Components + SSE Keep-Alive + Reconnect Badge
goal: Make liveness operator-visible. 15s SSE heartbeat (was 25s). EventSource auto-reconnect with exponential backoff. Reconnect badge fills <span data-conn="state"> placeholder. Sticky chrome regions (chrome / command-strip / scanbar / sec-nav) render from P137 snapshot keys.

decisions.decision: Heartbeat 25s → 15s per v3.4 INTENT invariant #10. Reconnect-detection threshold = 2 missed pings (30s) before RECONNECTING badge fires.
Exponential backoff 500/1000/2000/4000/8000ms (capped). After 5 retries → OFFLINE state. Visible badge transitions on every state change.
STALE tier fires when (a) last snapshot age > 2x RECONNECT_THRESHOLD (60s), OR (b) any _sources entry tier != fresh and not excused. This is the client-side mirror of R19 binding gate.
Chrome rendering is client-side DOM injection into placeholders. renderHtml() byte-shape unchanged. No new server-side template work.
A/P/O/Esc handlers log to console only; real REST endpoints wire in P139+. Listener skips INPUT/TEXTAREA/contentEditable to avoid eating keystrokes.

deferred_items: P139+ — wire A/P/O/Esc to real REST endpoints (currently console.log stubs)

P138 SAC-08 is a static surrogate (asserts setInterval=15000ms). A live SSE timing probe would boot a test server; SAC-P132-04/-05 pattern was followed (skip-when-no-port). Live probe not yet implemented.

consumers: v3.4/P139 (consumes the rendered chrome state — MissionCard + PhaseRunway etc. live below chrome)
v3.4/P140+ (assumes data-conn badge is operator-visible for incident triage)
constraints: Heartbeat is LOCKED at 15000ms — operator-visible liveness contract.
data-conn-tier attribute on <span data-conn="state"> takes values: pending|live|reconnecting|offline|stale. CSS in sgsd-design-system.css must color-bind these tiers.
Chrome placeholders (data-region=chrome|command|scanbar|sec-nav) are LOCKED. P139-P142 may add child elements but not rename the regions.
Hotkey listener is global. P139+ handlers must not double-register on the same keys.
extension_points: P139+ may extend keydown listener with additional shortcuts; the existing branch list is the convention
P141 may add per-source pill click handlers in sec-nav (currently links only)

source_commits.subject: feat(P138): sticky chrome + 15s SSE ping + reconnect badge — liveness operator-visible

codex_runs.result: All 6 tasks orchestrator-authored — serve.cjs heartbeat tighten, client.js rewrite (connState + 4 chrome renderers + hotkeys), SAC tests, phase close. Codex skipped for content-locked structural JS.
